text_block_list.text:
Summer camp had ended,
and while everyone was preparing to return to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Take a look, Trainer-kun.
At the expressions on our students' faces.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Ryan-chan!
Let's race each other as soon as we get back!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I grew so much during this training camp!
I'm definitely not gonna lose~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's my line!
My heart's been pounding nonstop since this morning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to know how much stronger I've gotten!
I want to test my current abilities!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Truly, full of boundless vitality.
I can genuinely feel my own growth.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who built up their strength over the summer
all uniformly display spectacular results in their races.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they will have
a truly spectacular debut.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If this can contribute even a little to everyone's future,
then all my meticulous preparations will have been well worth it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Do I appear so frail
that you think something of this level could bring me down?"

"...There isn't a single trace left
of the hesitation she showed during the training camp."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"What is it, Trainer-kun?
Is something on your mind?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The intent behind that question is...
asking whether I've grown through this training camp, I presume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, naturally, the preparations for a breakthrough are complete.
Expect nothing less than a ferocious, lionhearted performance."
—And with that, our heated summer training camp came to an end.
